hero.title: One VPS, declared in git.
hero.lead: A GitOps Kubernetes platform running real production apps on a single 1 vCPU / 4 GB node. Everything is declared in one repository; ArgoCD keeps the cluster matching it.

arch.title: Architecture
arch.lead: Merge to the git repository is the only deploy action. ArgoCD watches it and self-heals the cluster to match; Traefik terminates TLS and routes every hostname; cert-manager issues certificates automatically.

infra.title: Infrastructure
infra.c1d: Lightweight Kubernetes with Traefik, CoreDNS, and local-path storage in one binary. No etcd, state in sqlite.
infra.c2d: SSH key-only, fail2ban, a firewalled node-exporter, and 2 GB swap. The host hardening is part of the bootstrap script.
infra.c3d: One script turns a fresh VPS into the full platform. Migrating machines takes about thirty minutes.

tech.title: Technologies
tech.lead: Every layer is open source and declared in the repository.

svc.title: Services running on it
svc.chess: Real-time multiplayer chess with Stockfish analysis and Glicko-2 ratings.
svc.pixel: A Gather-style 2D world with movement, proximity chat, and proximity voice.
svc.argo: The GitOps control plane and a live dashboard of every deployed app.
svc.grafana: The curated HomeLab Overview dashboard, node health to per-app metrics.

mon.title: Monitoring and networking
mon.m1d: One curated Grafana dashboard in four sections (VPS, Kubernetes, ChessKernel, PixelHub). Both app servers expose cluster-internal metrics scraped by Prometheus every minute.
mon.m2d: One wildcard DNS record serves any number of hosts. Traefik routes by hostname (SNI) and cert-manager issues a Let's Encrypt certificate per host automatically.
mon.m3d: Secrets are sealed and safe in a public repo, TLS is everywhere, and the metrics endpoints are never exposed publicly.
mon.m4d: A nightly database dump to Cloudflare R2 with guardrails that keep it inside the free tier.
